description: The U.K. National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) has recommended brentuximab vedotin, within its marketing authorisation, as an option for treating relapsed or refractory systemic anaplastic large cell lymphoma in adults with an ECOG performance status of 0 or 1. Brentuximab vedotin is recommended within its marketing authorisation and subject to the commercial access agreement with NHS England.
